name: Teams Meetings
author: Zakaria Agoulif
description: Your next Teams meeting and its countdown in the bar, sticky when it starts, gone when you join.

barWidget.description: Next meeting from Teams for Linux with a countdown; turns urgent when a meeting starts until you join.

schema.label: Show upcoming meetings within
schema.description: Minutes. The bar shows the next meeting only when it starts within this window.

schema.label: Toast lead time
schema.description: Minutes before the start at which the optional toast fires. 0 means at start.

schema.label: Also send a desktop notification
schema.description: Off keeps everything in the bar. On sends one notification per meeting.

schema.label: Refresh calendar every
schema.description: Minutes between calendar requests to Teams for Linux.

schema.label: MQTT port
schema.description: Local port the built-in broker listens on. Change only if 1883 is taken, then press Connect again.

schema.label: MQTT topic prefix
schema.description: Must match Teams for Linux. Connect writes it for you.
